notes: All 308 items in exports/import/sat_reading_writing.jsonl were read in full (passage, stem, choices, key). Candidates were also cross-checked with an exact/near-identical choice-set scan and a TF-IDF passage-similarity scan.

Template threshold used: same rule, same keyed form, and at least 3 of 4 choices identical once the shared stem word is removed. Items that share only the skill, or the same choice set with a different key, were kept.

Several passage-repeat groups (119/194, 179/228, 027/165, 152/233) repeat only the context of a short grammar or vocabulary item. Rewriting the later item's context sentence would fix the repeat as well as retiring it.
Keep choice follows earliest import_id in every group; no later item was clearly better.
Import IDs are not contiguous (for example 011, 034, 043 are absent); the count reflects the 308 lines present.

decision.rule: Same rule as the ACT English/Reading 300-item audits: retire every passage/premise repeat where the repeated content is what the item tests (same inference, argument, storyline, dataset, or word-in-context concept), and every template copy whose context-free choice set is identical or differs only by one swapped form with the same keyed form. Keep items that merely share a skill or a background setting sentence while testing something different, and standard punctuation formats whose choice sets differ.
